scope: M07-S1 local inventory vertical slice only

criteria.requirement: Limit code changes to config/workspace-dependency-policy.json, scripts/workspace-dependency-audit.mjs, and tests/workspace-dependency-audit.test.js. Do not edit workspace manifests, root package scripts, unrelated source, or tests/workspace-dependency-manifest.test.js.
criteria.evidence: Post-build changed-path inventory compared with the candidate baseline and final diff review.

criteria.requirement: Encode the four approved recommendations exactly: the three named Harness packages are the only M07-S1 public compatibility candidates; all other packages remain UNKNOWN; project references apply only to explicitly named owners in approved profiles, with no profile approved by this gate; source roles remain distinct and unknown roles fail closed; no exception is active by default and each future exception carries the required edge, owner, reason, approval, candidate, and review/exit fields.
criteria.evidence: Policy validation and focused positive/negative synthetic fixtures.

criteria.requirement: Inventory every workspace owner and configured source file from the frozen candidate, or report a visible coverage gap that prevents a complete-scope claim. Classify production, test, build-only, type-only, and unresolved roles separately; do not infer conformance from UNKNOWN or UNRESOLVED evidence.
criteria.evidence: Candidate-bound JSON inventory report, owner/file counts, and explicit unresolved/coverage findings.

criteria.requirement: Produce deterministic normalized findings and bind the report to the implementation, policy, and source candidate. Reject unsafe output paths and keep output within the M07 evidence directory.
criteria.evidence: Synthetic determinism, stale-fingerprint, and path-escape fixtures plus the full inventory report.

criteria.requirement: Use only synthetic/local inputs. The checker must not import or execute workspace packages, invoke a shell, spawn child processes, access network services, start a service/database, install dependencies, or read real operational data. No manifest is changed in S1.
criteria.evidence: Code review, focused tests, command transcript, and before/after manifest hashes.

criteria.requirement: Run the focused M07 tests and existing dependency-direction regression, followed by the repository-required full test, typecheck, lint, and configured coverage gates. Any unapproved service/database/network requirement stops that command and leaves it NOT_RUN.
criteria.evidence: Candidate-bound command record with exact command, tool versions, exit status, and output artifact for each check.

criteria.requirement: Freeze a post-implementation execution candidate before the first test/check. Demonstrate that only the three approved M07 code paths changed relative to the prepared source baseline; record any pre-existing failure separately without repairing unrelated files.
criteria.evidence: Post-build source manifest and fingerprint, baseline comparison, and candidate-drift report.

criteria.requirement: Complete lead review and request a fresh-context independent I1 review. If I1 is unavailable, record UNAVAILABLE and retain CONDITIONAL_PASS; do not claim an independent approval or unconditional closure.
criteria.evidence: Frozen-bar lead review and independent critic report or explicit availability record.

criteria.requirement: Keep rollback bounded to the three M07-owned files and M07 evidence. Preserve all pre-existing worktree edits, historical evidence, and the AUD19-011 test; production remains NO_GO and G21-5/G21-6 remain closed.

decision_rule.pass: All critical criteria pass on one frozen execution candidate; report unresolved edges visibly; all required local gates pass.
decision_rule.conditional_pass: No critical safety/scope failure, but independent I1 review is unavailable or a noncritical criterion is incomplete.
decision_rule.fail: Any critical safety, scope, candidate-integrity, or required-gate criterion fails.
decision_rule.not_run: No implementation or check result may be inferred before the separate human M07-S1 BUILD gate is approved.

authorization: This bar and its candidate baseline are gate-preparation evidence only; they do not authorize implementation or command execution.
